items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: One of the finest, one of the best singers I ever played for wasn't a Jazz singer. That's the funny part of it. Evelyn Knight.

ctx.x: Incidentally, speaking of George Shearing, I think he is probably one of the finest solo pianists I have ever heard in my life. I admire George Shearing very much, and I like him personally.

But to get back to the singers... I played for so many singers, I can't even tell you... One of the finest, one of the best singers I ever played for wasn't a Jazz singer. That's the funny part of it. Evelyn Knight. She was a socialite type. She worked at the Palmer House, and this and that, you know... Boy, what a woman! She was something else. I loved that girl! And she sang songs like "Grandfather's Clock" and "A Little Bird Told Me That You..." -- and she didn't want me to do nothin' but just OMM-CHI,…
She had guys chasing her... She was a beautiful girl!
